``` r
library(OpenMx)
library(fitVARMxID)
library(metaDyn)
library(manMetaVAR)
```















## Data Generation


``` r
taskid <- 10
seed <- 42
set.seed(seed)
data <- GenData(
  taskid = taskid,
  seed = seed
)
```


``` r
plot(data)
```

<img src="fig-vignettes-sim-rep-unnamed-chunk-11-1.png" alt="" width="3300" /><img src="fig-vignettes-sim-rep-unnamed-chunk-11-2.png" alt="" width="3300" />

``` r
summary(data)
```

## MetaVAR


``` r
dtvar <- FitDTVAR(
  data = data,
  seed = seed
)
```


``` r
summary(dtvar, means = TRUE)
#> Call:
#> FitVARMxID(data = data$data, observed = paste0("y", seq_len(model$k)),
```

``` r
metavar <- FitMetaVAR(
  fit = dtvar,
  seed = seed
)
```

## Mplus (Default Priors)

``` r
    data = data,
    default_priors = TRUE,
    seed = seed
  )
```

``` r
    data = data,
    default_priors = TRUE,
    seed = seed
  )
```
